industryRestrictions: Do not collect or infer protected health information.
Do not send form fields, user identifiers, appointment identifiers, treatment details, URLs with query values, or page metadata containing prohibited data.
Unknown or unapproved routes must not load GA4.
leadDefinition: A generate_lead event fires only after the Worker validates the appointment request and the approved Resend handoff accepts it for delivery to the dental office. It is a received lead/request, never a booked or confirmed appointment.
